description: Header file defining structures, macros, enums, and function prototypes for the Linux driver of Intel SmartPHY DSL PCIe Endpoint/ACA. It includes device configuration, hardware operations, and interface functions for managing EP devices and their resources.

methods.name: dc_ep_dev_num_get
methods.description: Returns the total number of attached EP devices.

methods.name: dc_ep_dev_info_req
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific EP device by index and interrupt module.

methods.name: dc_ep_dev_info_release
methods.description: Releases the reference to an EP device, indicating it is no longer in use.
